Fault codes:

- `duplicate_invoice` — an invoice number that already appears earlier in the ledger

Rules: GST is 10%, so GST inside a GST-inclusive amount is `amount / 11` rounded to the nearest cent. GST-free categories are basic_food, education, export, medical. Input-taxed categories are financial_supply, residential_rent and give no input tax credit. Out-of-period and duplicate entries are excluded from the BAS entirely. A purchase missing its ABN over the threshold still appears in the ledger but its GST cannot be claimed at 1B.
